# Design: Lintel v3.6 — Alias Mechanism (Cohort 4 prereq)

**Generated by:** `/office-hours` adversarial pass on 2026-05-28
**Branch:** `v3.6-cohort-4a-alias-design`
**Repo:** jokerman89/jokerman-lintel
**Status:** DRAFT — design pass, awaiting operator WS-4a + WS-4b execution
**Mode:** Builder
**Supersedes:** none (kompletterar [lintel-v3.6-backlog-sequencing.md](lintel-v3.6-backlog-sequencing.md))

> Per v3.6 backlog Cohort 4 needs alias-mekanism (4.1) som pre-req för naming-rename-work (4.2 gstack-collision sort + 4.4 orphan-names). Detta dokument specar alias-mekanismens shape så att rename-work kan genomföras icke-breaking. Adresserar plan-eng-review Reviewer Concern: "4.1 alias mechanism shape ospecificerad".

## Problem Statement

Cohort 4 backlog kräver alias-mekanism FÖRE rename-work eftersom skills som kallar andra skills (e.g., orchestrator → sub-skill) skulle bryta vid rename utan alias-period. Backlog säger "Build this before any rename. Old skill names redirect to new with warning, don't break."

Tre delar av Lintel som behöver alias-stöd:

1. **Skill-folder rename** (e.g., `skills/old-name/` → `skills/new-name/`)
2. **Env-var rename** (e.g., `$JSTACK_HOME` → `$LINTEL_HOME`, partiellt klart i Cohort 1)
3. **Plugin-namespace rename** (osannolikt i denna fas men shape-supporterat)

## What Makes This Cool

**One mechanism, three domains.** Samma alias-pattern (mapping + deprecation-window + warn-on-resolve) appliceras konsekvent över skill-namn, env-var-namn, och plugin-slugs. Inga special-cases.

**Operator-grace-period inbyggd.** Old name fortsätter att fungera i N versions/days; warning surfar vid resolution men blockar inte. Operator hinner uppdatera muscle-memory + dokumentation.

**CI-enforcement post-grace.** Efter grace-period kan alias removal-PR mergea utan att bryta operator-workflows som redan migrerat.

## Constraints

- **Icke-breaking.** Old name → new name resolution måste fungera transparent under grace-period
- **Auditbar.** Alias-resolution loggar till `~/.lintel/audit/alias-resolution.jsonl` så vi ser vilka aliases som faktiskt används (data → action: keep alias if used, remove if cold)
- **Compose:able.** Skill aliases får inte krocka med plugin-namespace `/li:` prefix
- **Discoverable.** `bin/li-doctor --aliases` listar alla active aliases + their resolution

## Premises

1. **Three alias kinds:** skill-folder alias, env-var alias, plugin-slug alias (last är osannolikt initially men shape stödjer)
2. **Mapping centraliserad** i `config/aliases.yaml` — single source of truth
3. **Resolution sker at first-touch** (skill-invocation time, env-var first-read, plugin-list-time)
4. **Grace-period default:** 90 days (operator-overridable per alias)
5. **Removal kräver explicit PR** — aldrig auto-removal under v3.6 cycle

## Approaches Considered

### Approach A: Symlinks (rejected)
Skill-folder rename: `ln -s skills/new-name skills/old-name`.
- **Rejected:** Windows-poor support. Operator-CI-Windows breaks. Plus inte applicerbart till env-vars.

### Approach B: Frontmatter `aliases:` array (rejected för skill-folder)
Add `aliases: [old-name, alt-name]` till SKILL.md frontmatter. Plugin/skill-resolution checkar frontmatter.
- **Rejected för folder-rename:** Skill-folder fortfarande heter old-name så `find skills/old-name/SKILL.md` finds the file, but external callers (other skills som calls `/li:old-name`) fortfarande bryter eftersom plugin-manifest pekar på actual folder.
- **Partial-keep:** För invocation-aliases (`/li:old-invocation-name` → `/li:new-invocation-name`) detta är användbart men inte folder-level.

### Approach C: Central dispatcher-table (CHOSEN)
`config/aliases.yaml` definierar all alias-mappings. Dispatcher-lookup vid skill-invocation, env-var-read, plugin-list. Removed alias → operator sees clean error.

**Pros:**
- Single source of truth
- Lätt att audit (just read the file)
- Composable över alla 3 domains
- Operator kan se all aliases via `/li:doctor --aliases`

**Cons:**
- Adds en lookup-step per skill-invocation (cost: ~1ms — negligible)
- Requires dispatcher integration i plugin-namespace handlers

## Recommended Approach — Central dispatcher

### config/aliases.yaml schema

```yaml
version: 1
as_of: 2026-05-28

skill_aliases:
  # old-name: new-name + metadata
  - old: old-skill-name
    new: new-skill-name
    deprecated_at: 2026-05-28
    removal_at: 2026-08-28      # 90-day grace
    reason: "rename för clarity (D-4a working session 2026-05-28)"

env_var_aliases:
  # OLD_VAR_NAME: NEW_VAR_NAME + metadata
  - old: JSTACK_HOME
    new: LINTEL_HOME
    deprecated_at: 2026-05-28
    removal_at: 2026-06-28      # shorter grace för var-renames (already done i Cohort 1)
    reason: "Phase A JStack → Lintel rebrand"

plugin_slug_aliases:
  # (likely empty initially — but shape-supported)
```

### Resolution mechanism

**Skill-folder-alias resolution:**

At `/li:<name>` invocation, dispatcher (hook eller plugin-manifest handler) does:
1. Check `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` exists
2. If not, check `config/aliases.yaml` skill_aliases för match
3. If aliased: log resolution till `~/.lintel/audit/alias-resolution.jsonl`, warn till stderr ("⚠ /li:<old> is deprecated, use /li:<new> (removed after <date>)"), proceed med new-name skill
4. If not aliased + not exists: error "no skill /li:<name>"

**Env-var alias resolution:**

Bin-scripts som läser env-vars do:
1. Read `$NEW_VAR_NAME` first
2. If empty, read `$OLD_VAR_NAME` (per aliases.yaml)
3. If old populated + new empty: log + warn ("⚠ $OLD_VAR_NAME deprecated, please switch to $NEW_VAR_NAME"), use old-value

This kan implementeras som a shared helper sourced av all bin-scripts:

```bash
# bin/_aliases.sh — sourced helper
resolve_env_var() {
  local new_name="$1"
  local new_value="${!new_name:-}"
  if [ -n "$new_value" ]; then
    echo "$new_value"
    return
  fi
  # Check alias
  while IFS=: read -r old new; do
    if [ "$new" = "$new_name" ]; then
      local old_value="${!old:-}"
      if [ -n "$old_value" ]; then
        echo "⚠ \$$old deprecated, use \$$new_name" >&2
        echo "$old_value"
        return
      fi
    fi
  done < <(parse aliases.yaml env_var_aliases)
}
```

### Audit-log format

`~/.lintel/audit/alias-resolution.jsonl`:

```json
{
  "ts": "2026-05-28T15:00:00Z",
  "kind": "skill|env_var|plugin_slug",
  "old": "old-name",
  "new": "new-name",
  "context": "invocation-cli=claude-code OR env-var-read=bin/li-doctor:11"
}
```

Operator: `/li:doctor --aliases --usage` shows usage-counts per alias → data-driven decision för removal-PR timing.

## Open Questions

1. **Should alias-removal go through deprecation-skill or just be a regular PR?**
   - Recommendation: regular PR med `removal_at` date as commit-trigger reference
2. **Plugin-namespace aliases** unlikely needed initially. Skip until use case emerges.
3. **Bin-script aliases** (e.g., `li-doctor` was once `jstack-doctor`): Cohort 1 hard-renamed these utan alias. Defensible eftersom rebrand already done in Phase A. Future renames bör använda alias-period.

## Success Criteria

- `config/aliases.yaml` exists med initial state
- `bin/_aliases.sh` helper present + sourced by bin-scripts
- Plugin-dispatcher (in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` eller equivalent) checks alias-yaml
- Test: deprecated `/li:old-name` resolves to `/li:new-name` med warning
- Test: deprecated `$JSTACK_HOME` resolves to `$LINTEL_HOME` med warning (Cohort 1 cleanup-path)
- `bin/li-doctor --aliases` lists active aliases

## Distribution Plan

Cohort 4-implementation distribueras via standard Lintel install/update path. config/aliases.yaml ships as part av repo. Helper bin/_aliases.sh installed via install/install.sh.

## Dependencies

- WS-4a (operator working session): determines vilka skills som faktiskt får aliases
- WS-4b (orphan-name decisions): determines vilka orphan-names blir aliased vs hard-removed
- Cohort 1 har redan demonstrerat hard-rename utan alias (acceptable för Phase A-completion)

## Next Steps

1. **Operator schedule WS-4a + WS-4b** working sessions (2-3h total)
2. **Implementation PR opens AFTER WS-4a/b** med:
   - `config/aliases.yaml` populated från WS-decisions
   - `bin/_aliases.sh` helper
   - Plugin-dispatcher integration
   - Tests (deprecated-resolution + audit-log)
3. **Cohort 4 naming-sort PR opens AFTER alias-mechanism merged**
4. **90-day grace period start** when first alias added
5. **Removal-PRs** filed after grace-period per alias-entry

## What I noticed about how you think

- Du explicit bad om alias-pre-req i backlog ("build this before any rename") — du har sett tidigare rename utan alias bita dig
- Du accepterade hard-rename i Cohort 1 (JStack → Lintel) utan alias eftersom rebrand-kontraktet var explicit i Phase A — du distinguishes between "ongoing-rename" och "completed-rebrand-cleanup"
- "On the fly i pågående arbete" gäller fortfarande — denna design-doc öppnas som PR men merges INTE förrän operator-sessions WS-4a/b genomförts. Inget alias byggs i förväg utan use-case
